note: Every figure is computed using only races run STRICTLY BEFORE the race it describes — the `as_of` date on each horse. Groups with fewer than two runs are omitted rather than shown as a rate, because a 100% strike rate over one run is noise wearing the clothes of a finding. Our archive runs to 2026-09-24: a horse that ran after that date has those runs missing here, so read `career` as what we hold, not as a complete record.
